summary: Sister of Carmine G. Fiorillo, born at Aiello Calabro about 1813, who married Nicola Vecchio at San Mango in 1839.
bio: Cintia Gabriele Fiorillo, also recorded as Giacinta, was born about 1813 at Aiello Calabro, Cosenza. She was a sister of Carmine G. Fiorillo. On 7 February 1839 she married Nicola Vecchio at San Mango.
